caption: The drawing depicts a girl's dress and matching pantalettes rendered in pencil and possibly ink or another dark medium on a yellowed, tan-colored paper. The dress features short, puffed sleeves with lace-trimmed edges, a square neckline with lace detail, and is decorated on the bodice and the front panel with intricate floral designs and lace borders. The skirt of the dress is full, falling just below the knees, and also has embroidery and lace trim near the hem. The matching pantalettes, visible beneath the dress, reach to the mid-calf and are decorated with similar lace and floral embroidery near the cuffs. In the upper right corner of the drawing, a smaller, less detailed outline of the same dress and pantalettes is included, providing a view of the full garment from a different perspective. The overall composition centers on the detailed clothing items, with no other objects or background elements present.
title: Child's Dress
